statement: The pinned InputPlumber Switch Pro device profile matches the 057e:2009 Pro ID and a Pro Controller name; it is not itself a Joy-Con 2006/2007 input profile. Availability of a dedicated Joy-Con profile is not established by this source.

applicability.revision: SDL2 release-2.30.12 at 8236e01; SDL3 at 535d80b; Linux v5.16 df0cc57 and later 4056b3c; joycond 0df025a; HHD 4184f03; all source-only
applicability.scope: Negative finding limited to the selected Pro profile, not an exhaustive scan of all versions.
